result:
rough assumption (§7.3, §19).
- `test_unknowns_are_listed_apart_and_never_change_the_verdict`: `unknowns` equals the `unknown` checks, and Mateo is coherent with a non-empty list (D3, §7.5).
- `test_every_check_carries_a_derived_from_chain`: every check, unknown and G1 check has a non-empty `derived_from` of strings, and the status is one of the five allowed values (§12).
- `test_every_explanation_segment_has_a_tag_and_a_ref`: every segment, in the explanation and in each section narrative, has a kind in {fact, assumption, inference, unknown}, text and refs (§9.2, §12).
- `test_disclaimer_is_the_fixed_text`: the report and explanation disclaimers equal the fixed French text verbatim (§9.4).
- `test_known_limitations_come_from_the_report`: `assumptions` carry the window, drift (assumed), survivorship and no-look-through limitations. AMF, CIRO and "noisy"/"bruit" must appear in the report or the page (§19). That last check is a stricter reading of §19, noted with a `# SPEC-AMBIGUITY:` comment.
- `test_build_leaves_repo_state_alone`: fixtures and `data/meta/activity_tags.csv` are unchanged by the build (invariant 6).
- `test_page_defines_and_uses_every_render_hook`: `renderStress`, `renderGoals`, `renderLookthrough`, `renderDerivedFrom`, `segmentTag`, `renderUnknowns`, `renderLimitations`, `renderValuesRules` and `assumptionBadge` are each defined once and used elsewhere.
- `test_page_keeps_the_tabs_the_picker_and_reads_only_report_json`: the seven French tabs and the picker are kept, `reports/index.json` is read, every `fetch` targets `reports/`, and there is no external script.
- `test_stress_renderer_shows_scenarios_and_the_assumption_badge`: the stress renderer builds a table from `scenarios`, `shock_bp` and `impact`, reads `sourced`, `assumptions` and `status`, and calls `assumptionBadge(`.
- `test_goals_renderer_shows_g1_probabilities_as_info_with_assumptions`: the goals renderer reads `goal_probs`, `prob`, `name`, `amount` and `assumptions`, calls `assumptionBadge(`, and applies no violation or warning styling (§7.3).
- `test_lookthrough_renderer_says_etf_sectors_are_not_looked_through`: the renderer branches on `lookthrough`, takes the H6/H10 ids from `unknowns`, and its French text mentions FNB, secteur and inconnu.
- `test_derived_from_chain_is_clickable_on_each_check`: check rows carry `data-check`, a click handler is bound, and `renderDerivedFrom` reads `derived_from` and is called (§12).
- `test_segment_tags_on_every_explanation_segment`: `segmentTag` is called for both explanation and narrative segments, and the four French labels (fait, hypothèse, inférence, inconnu) are present (§12).
- `test_unknowns_list_is_titled_what_we_cannot_verify`: the page has « Ce qu'on ne peut pas vérifier » and `renderUnknowns` reads `report.unknowns` (D3).
- `test_limitations_renderer_reads_the_report_assumptions`: `renderLimitations` reads `assumptions`, the page has a "Limites" title, and the renderer's literal text has no digits (§19).
- `test_values_rules_have_display_only_approve_and_reject_buttons`: `data-action="approve"` and `data-action="reject"` exist, they use `approved_by_user` or S4, and the renderer makes no request (§12 N3).
- `test_disclaimer_is_shown_verbatim_from_the_report`: the footer prints `rep.disclaimer`, and any disclaimer literal in the page equals the fixed text (§9.4).
- `test_new_renderers_type_no_numbers`: the new renderers' literal text contains no digits, so every number comes from the report JSON.
- `test_page_has_no_advisory_wording`: none of the phrases from `explain.ADVISORY_BLOCKLIST` (plus a few "achetez"/"vendez"/"buy now" additions) appears anywhere in the page.

I named the hooks (the nine function names and the `data-check` and `data-action` attributes) myself, because the spec doesn't give names. The implementation has to use them, and the module docstring lists them.

The existing page prints `0${i}` in `factorPage`, which my digit scan would flag. The new renderers must avoid that pattern.
